chunks: Yet they are my enemies except the Lord of all the worlds
ai.seo_question: Who are the enemies of Prophet Muhammad according to Surah The Poets?
ai.summary: In Surah Ash-Shu'ara (26:90), the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declares his enmity towards those who oppose divine truth, reserving his ultimate loyalty for Allah alone. This verse underscores the concept of *al-wala' wa al-baraa'* (alliance and disavowal) in Shia theology, highlighting that true allegiance is to God, distinguishing the faithful from their detractors. It serves as a reminder of the Prophet's steadfastness amidst opposition, reinforcing the spiritual hierarchy where divine connection supersedes worldly affiliations.
